## 🛠 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 **Bug fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) -> _Title should start with `fix:`_
- [ ] ✨ **New feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality) -> _Title should start with `feat:`_
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking change** (fix or feature that breaks existing functionality) -> _Title should start with `feat!:` or `fix!:`_
- [ ] 🧹 **Chore / Refactor** (internal code changes, no visual/logic changes) -> _Title should start with `chore:`_

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have tested on **iOS Simulator/Device**
- [ ] I have tested on **Android Emulator/Device**
- [ ] (If applicable) I have updated the documentation
